title: Kachnarguggul
description: Kachnarguggul (Kanchanar Guggul) is a premier formulation using Kanchanar bark to break down abnormal tissue accumulations and address hormonal imbalances. This classical preparation treats thyroid imbalances including goiter (thyroid enlargement) and hypothyroidism through tissue-normalizing action. Ovarian cysts, which are abnormal tissue growths in the female reproductive system, are addressed through the formulation's ability to prevent further growth and promote resorption. Uterine fibroids (benign muscle tumors in the uterus) shrink through regular use. Swollen lymph nodes respond to this formulation's lymphatic system support. This formulation represents Ayurveda's approach to abnormal tissue management.
